This is a lean4export format 3.1.0 regression fixture copied from
[ammkrn/nanoda_lib](https://github.com/ammkrn/nanoda_lib/tree/8de7e0c4ed3052745a7f8725164efd9e76d84c56/test_resources/ProjFromProp/export),
licensed Apache-2.0. It exercises dependent inductive checking and definitions.

It was originally exported using Lean 4.27.0-rc1. The production Lean
toolchain for Vastitas is independently pinned to 4.35.0; the fixture tests
the stable export format, not the full current Mathlib environment.
